name: Liam Tremblay
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport HR was somewhat unconventional. After completing his degree in Human Resources Management at the University of Toronto, he initially worked in the corporate sector, but always felt a pull towards the adrenaline and innovation of racing. A chance volunteer opportunity at a local motorsport event ignited his passion, leading him to pursue specialized training in recruitment and talent management within the industry.

At Rexal FMI Racing, Liam focuses on cultivating a supportive and high-performance team culture. He believes in identifying and nurturing talent from diverse backgrounds, ensuring that every team member has the resources and opportunities to reach their full potential. He's known for his data-driven approach to HR, using analytics to optimize recruitment strategies and improve employee satisfaction, leading to a more efficient and motivated workforce.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a lean build and an approachable demeanor.

Starts every Monday with a team-building icebreaker.
